# QSC Solutions Brand Instructions

This repository is for QSC Solutions branding and digital design work. Before any design, frontend, marketing, or HTML/CSS change, read `QSC_BRAND_GUIDELINES.md`.

Mandatory rules:

- Use the official QSC Solutions identity, website, tagline, and contact details exactly as documented in `QSC_BRAND_GUIDELINES.md`.
- Use the official brand colours and shared design tokens from `styles/qsc-design-tokens.css` instead of introducing alternate values.
- Preserve the official logo and tagline exactly; do not create a text-only replacement or misspell “QUALITY SPEED CONSISTENCY.”
- If the official logo asset is missing, ask the repository owner to provide it instead of inventing or approximating a replacement.
- Preserve existing functionality and repository conventions unless the user explicitly requests a design change.
- Prefer accessible, responsive, readable layouts with the QSC brand style.
- Keep changes consistent with the project’s current structure and reuse tokens/components instead of introducing competing design systems.

If a design decision conflicts with the official brand rules, the official logo and exact palette win. Ask for clarification when required.
